name: Atari Lynx
significance: Pioneered hardware sprite zooming, scaling, and distortion in a handheld console, engineered by Epyx legends RJ Mical and Dave Needle.

editorialContent.overview: The world's first handheld electronic game console with a color LCD screen, featuring hardware sprite scaling and ambidextrous ergonomics.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Pioneered hardware sprite zooming, scaling, and distortion in a handheld console, engineered by Epyx legends RJ Mical and Dave Needle.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Reversible ambidextrous directional pad and dual fire button pairs
